# Three.js

Pinned version: 0.186.1, distributed under the MIT license in `LICENSE`.

Files are served locally so the party board does not depend on a third-party CDN at runtime.

- `three.module.min.js`: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.186.1/build/three.module.min.js
- `three.core.js`: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.186.1/build/three.core.min.js
- `LICENSE`: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.186.1/LICENSE

The minified core is named `three.core.js` to match the relative import in the module build.
